studio_tagline: The studio that never leaves the phone.
studio_promise: No upload. No account. No watermark. No monthly fee.
studio_privacy_body: PixiJoy edits photos and movies on this device. Your pictures are not uploaded. Optional on-device packs download a model file only after you tap Download.
create_source_subtitle: Photo or movie — edits stay on this device.
studio_hub_sub: Photo and movie. All on this phone.
studio_movie_caption: Trim, motion, talking stills — encoded here.
studio_recents_empty: Your recents will show up here.
tool_best_for_move: Best for: turn a photo into video
tool_expand_sub: Mirror pixels past the photo edges
tool_layers_sub: Best for: combine photos and text
export_leave_safe: You can leave the app — export continues in the background.
studio_export_exif_gps_hint: Remove location from exported photo. GPS is always stripped.
studio_pick_body: Photo first, then the tool. Nothing leaves this phone.
studio_pick_body_movie: Clip first, then the tool. Nothing leaves this phone.
studio_layout_export_hint: Layout is always applied at export.
studio_layout_preview_single: Single layout previews live and matches export.
studio_layout_preview_wysiwyg: Live WYSIWYG layout preview. Multi-layout seeking is unavailable; play from the start.
studio_layout_preview_export_only: Live layout preview is not supported on this device. Export remains correct.
studio_layout_seek_unavailable: Seeking is unavailable for multi-layout preview. Play from the start; export remains correct.
session_project_missing: This project is no longer available.
studio_empty_canvas: Pick a tool, then a photo.
studio_movie_placeholder: Trim, concat, and talking stills land in the movie slice. The clip is already on this phone.
studio_move_hint: Slow zoom and pan, encoded on this phone.
studio_talking_hint: A gentle pulse on the still, encoded here.
studio_movie_d3_hint: Zoom and pan on this clip.
studio_movie_d4_hint: Title or caption on the timeline.
studio_movie_d6_vo_active: Voice-over is ducking the music bed.
studio_movie_d7_hint: PiP, split, or grid on export.
studio_movie_d8_hint: Steady crop zooms in to hide frame edges; it does not track motion.
studio_movie_d10_hint: Slow-mo holds frames until neural frames bind. Download the pack to unlock Neural frames.
studio_movie_d10_hint_ready: Neural frames are bound. Export synthesizes mid-frames; preview still shows rate/hold.
studio_export_hdr_keep_hint: Keeps HDR when this device can write it. Otherwise the export is SDR.
studio_export_gif_ok: Saved GIF to Pictures/PixiJoy. No watermark.
studio_camera_permission: PixiJoy takes photos and video on this phone. Nothing is uploaded.
studio_fill_hint: Paint to remove. Nearby-pixel fill is not neural. Neural Apply stays off until a sideloaded model is bound.
studio_pack_missing: Unavailable until this on-device pack is downloaded. Your photo stays on the phone; only the model file is fetched.
studio_pack_missing_sideload: This pack is not hosted for download in this build. Use Install from file, or copy the .tflite into the incoming folder. Play Store modules are not shipped yet.
studio_pack_ready_unbound: Downloaded and verified (Ready). The neural engine is not bound, so this tool does not run a model. Nearby-pixel fill is not neural.
studio_pack_ready_no_litert: Downloaded and verified (Ready). Play services LiteRT is unavailable, so the neural engine cannot start.
studio_pack_ready_no_engine: Installed and verified (Ready). Coming with pack. Not neural.
studio_pack_inpaint_ready: Installed and verified (Ready). The neural engine is not bound, so neural inpaint stays off. Nearby-pixel fill is not neural.
studio_pack_inpaint_ready_no_litert: Installed and verified (Ready). Play services LiteRT is unavailable, so the neural engine cannot start. Nearby-pixel fill is not neural.
studio_pack_inpaint_engine_ready: Neural ready. The sideloaded inpaint model is bound, so neural Apply can run it. Nearby-pixel fill stays available and is not neural.
studio_pack_sr_denoise_ready: Downloaded and verified (Ready). The neural engine is not bound, so Apply stays off and the photo is left unchanged.
studio_pack_sr_denoise_ready_no_litert: Downloaded and verified (Ready). Play services LiteRT is unavailable, so the neural engine cannot start and Apply stays off.
studio_pack_engine_ready: Neural ready. The on-device model is bound, so Apply can run it. Processing stays on this phone.
studio_pack_file_unreadable: Could not read the selected file.
studio_super_res_hint: 2× or 4× runs only when the neural engine is bound. Downloaded and verified (Ready) leaves Apply off. Export uses the same op. Large images are tiled.
studio_denoise_hint: Download fetches the pinned on-device UNet. Ready means the file is verified. Apply stays off until the neural engine binds. Preview and export use the same op.
studio_track_hint: Point track is coming with the pack. No motion follow in this build.
studio_sky_hint: Replace sky with a solid color. Background fallback uses a basic corner match.
studio_soften_hint: Light skin soften on this device.
studio_presets_hint: Save this edit stack as a preset on this phone. Apply later to any photo project.
studio_preset_unreadable: This preset could not be read.
studio_library_export_with_look: Export all photos with a look
studio_cutout_subject_available: Subject mask is available on this device.
studio_cutout_corner_fallback: Subject mask is unavailable. Basic cutout removes colors matching the photo corners.
studio_mask_subject_unavailable: Subject fill needs the on-device mask. Paint to refine instead.
studio_tap_place: Tap the photo to place it.
studio_looks_hint: Tap a look, then Apply. Or import a LUT.
studio_export_background: Exporting in the background. You can leave this screen.
studio_sample_unavailable: The built-in sample could not be opened.
studio_photo_render_failed: Couldn’t update the preview. Your previous preview is still available.
studio_layers_hint: Tap a layer to fade or blend.
studio_mask_hint: Subject fills the mask. Paint to refine.
studio_selective_hsl_hint: Pick a range, tweak, then Apply.
studio_cg_cube_note: Turn and pitch the cube. Scale changes its size.
studio_cg_ground_note: Horizon height and shadow. Yaw and pitch do not apply.
studio_cg_sky_note: Full-frame sky gradient. Place it behind the shot with Z-order.
studio_cg_dust_note: Mote size and drift direction. Pitch does not apply.
studio_cg_gltf_note: Place and turn the loaded mesh.
studio_pack_depth_ready: Installed and verified (Ready). The depth engine is not bound, so CG stays on manual Z-order. This is not neural depth.
studio_pack_depth_ready_no_litert: Installed and verified (Ready). Play services LiteRT is unavailable, so the depth engine cannot start. CG stays on manual Z-order.
studio_pack_depth_engine_ready: Neural ready. The depth model is bound, so CG plates hide where the scene is nearer. Manual Z still sets how close the plate sits.
studio_export_hdr_sdr_fallback: This device cannot write HDR, so this export is SDR.
studio_library_delete_all_body: Removes every project on this phone. This cannot be undone.
studio_library_reset_body: Deletes all projects and clears app settings on this phone. You will see the privacy screen again. Packs you downloaded stay until you remove them.
studio_assembly_hint: Markers, bins, and named cuts for director assemblies. Playhead and trims magnetize to clip edges.
studio_snap_hint: Magnetic snap: playhead and trim stick to clip edges within 120 ms.
studio_cg_hint: CG plates composite on the timeline. Load a glTF or GLB prop, then place and scale it. Lighting is classical until the CG module installs.
studio_cg_hint_filament: Prop glTF renders in Filament with a directional key and studio IBL. Cube, ground, sky, and dust stay classical. HDRI packs come later.
studio_deliver_hint: Presets, optional TC burn-in, review notes, and EDL/FCPXML handoff next to the project. Export still uses the export button.
studio_deliver_gaps: Gaps: EDL has no dissolves; FCPXML is cut-list lite; meta is a JSON sidecar (not muxed into MP4).
studio_title_3d_hint: Extruded 3D titles. Filament loads from an on-demand module when installed.
studio_ar_unsupported: ARCore not available on this device
studio_sound_hint: Stem buses, ADR record, slip sync, and LUFS target. Export applies mute/solo and loudness gate.
studio_vfx_hint: Particle layers composite over the timeline. Attach to track to follow the F1 seed.
studio_export_failed_help: Try again with a shorter clip or lower resolution. Keep the phone awake until the notification finishes.
studio_pack_failed_help: Check your connection and tap Retry. Only the model file downloads — your photo stays on this phone.
